name: clara
description: Clara supports commercial due-diligence preparation—market, customer, product, competitive, and operating evidence.

interface.longDescription: Clara helps consultants prepare commercial due diligence and other advisory work. She organizes evidence from documents, interviews and data, highlights gaps and contradictions, and analyzes markets, customers, products, competitors and operations. She turns the work into presentations, reports and reviewable workpapers, while Retailer Signals and Brand Fit help assess retailer requirements, a brand's current presence and its product catalogue. Sources, assumptions and open questions remain visible; the consultant keeps professional judgement.
defaultPrompt: Use Clara to organize the evidence, surface gaps and contradictions, and identify decisions that cannot wait.
Use Clara to run this interview, transcribe this recording, or correct this deck while preserving approved content.
Use Clara for Retailer Signals, Brand Fit, or reviewed dataset semantics; render the right business chart and check it.
